# Rust

Embed `vl-convert-rs` directly in Rust applications.

Start with [Installation](getting-started/installation.md), follow the [Quick Start](getting-started/quick-start.md), or consult the [API Reference](https://docs.rs/vl-convert-rs/2.0.0-rc7/vl_convert_rs/).
